q.p: In what year was İlkay Gündoğan born?
q.e: İlkay Gündoğan (Turkish: [ilˈkaj ˈɟyndoan]; born 24 October 1990) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Süper Lig club Galatasaray.

q.p: In what year was Charlene, Princess of Monaco born?
q.e: Charlene, Princess of Monaco: Charlene (French: Charlène [ʃaʁlɛn]; born Charlene Lynette Wittstock, 25 January 1978) is Princess of Monaco as the wife of Prince Albert II.

q.p: In what year was Canelo Álvarez born?
q.e: Canelo Álvarez: Santos Saúl "Canelo" Álvarez Barragán (Latin American Spanish: [saˈul ˈalβaɾes]; born 18 July 1990) is a Mexican professional boxer.

q.p: In what year was Ángel Di María born?
q.e: Ángel Di María: Known for his dribbling and playmaking, Di María is the all-time Argentine top assist provider in the UEFA Champions League (41) and ranks second overall.

q.p: In what year was Iga Świątek born?
q.e: Iga Świątek: Iga Natalia Świątek (born 31 May 2001) is a Polish professional tennis player.

q.p: In what year was Édouard Mendy born?
q.e: Édouard Mendy: Édouard Osoque Mendy (born 1 March 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli.

q.p: In what year was Erik ten Hag born?
q.e: Erik ten Hag (Dutch: [tɛn ˈɦɑx] ten HAKH; born 2 February 1970) is a Dutch professional football executive, former manager, and player.

q.p: In what year was Edwin van der Sar born?
q.e: Edwin van der Sar (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɛtʋɪɱ vɑn dər ˈsɑr]; born 29 October 1970) is a Dutch football executive and former player.

q.p: In what year was Petr Čech born?

q.p: In what year was Álvaro Morata born?
q.e: Álvaro Morata: Álvaro Borja Morata Martín (born 23 October 1992) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Como and the Spain national team.

q.p: In what year was Dricus du Plessis born?
q.e: Dricus du Plessis (born 14 January 1994), also known by his initials DDP, is a South African professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: In what year was Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer) born?
q.e: Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer): As a multi-functional striker who brought a new dimension to the position, Ronaldo has been an influence for a generation of strikers that have followed.

q.p: In what year was Hakan Çalhanoğlu born?
q.e: Hakan Çalhanoğlu: In 2017, Çalhanoğlu signed for AC Milan for an initial €20 million fee, before joining city rivals Inter on a free transfer in the summer of 2021.

q.p: In what year was Mesut Özil born?
q.e: Mesut Özil: Born and raised in Gelsenkirchen, Özil began his senior club career playing for hometown club Schalke 04, before signing with Werder Bremen in 2008, aged 19.

q.p: In what year was Tommy DeVito (American football) born?
q.e: Tommy DeVito (American football): Thomas DeVito (born August 7, 1998) is an American professional football quarterback for the New England Patriots of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: In what year did Sócrates die?
q.e: Sócrates played for Brazil for seven years, scoring 22 goals and representing the nation in two World Cups.

q.p: In what year was VfL Wolfsburg founded?
q.e: VfL Wolfsburg: V., commonly known as VfL Wolfsburg (pronounced [ˌfaʊ ʔɛf ʔɛl ˈvɔlfsbʊɐ̯k]), is a German professional sports club based in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony.

q.p: In what year was Bayer 04 Leverkusen founded?
q.e: Bayer 04 Leverkusen: It competes in the Bundesliga, the top tier of German football, and plays its home matches at the BayArena.

q.p: In what year was 1. FC Union Berlin founded?
q.e: 1. FC Union Berlin: V., commonly known as Union Berlin (pronounced [ˈeːɐ̯stɐ ʔɛfˈt͡seː ʔuˈni̯oːn bɛʁˈliːn]), is a professional German football club based in Berlin.

q.p: In what year was Brighton & Hove Albion F.C. founded?
q.e: Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.: Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club, commonly referred to as Brighton, is a professional football club based in Brighton and Hove, East Sussex, England.

q.p: In what year was Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah) founded?
q.e: Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah): Ittihad matches are played at Jeddah's main stadium King Abdullah Sports City, which is the second-largest stadium in Saudi Arabia, accommodating 66,345 spectators.

q.p: In what year was FC Schalke 04 founded?
q.e: FC Schalke 04: The "04" in the club's name derives from its formation in 1904.

q.p: In what year was All Elite Wrestling first released?
q.e: All Elite Wrestling (AEW) is an American professional wrestling promotion based in Jacksonville, Florida.

q.p: About how tall is Wilfried Gnonto?
q.e: The height of Wilfried Gnonto is about 1.55 m.

q.p: About how tall is Juan Martín del Potro?
q.e: The height of Juan Martín del Potro is about 1.98 m. Juan Martín del Potro (Spanish pronunciation: [xwam maɾˈtin del ˈpotɾo]; born 23 September 1988) is an Argentine former professional tennis player.

q.p: About how tall is Mason Rudolph (American football)?
q.e: The height of Mason Rudolph (American football) is about 1.96 m. Brett Mason Rudolph III (born July 17, 1995) is an American professional football quarterback for the Pittsburgh Steelers of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: About how tall is Édouard Mendy?
q.e: The height of Édouard Mendy is about 1.94 m. Édouard Osoque Mendy (born 1 March 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli.

q.p: About how tall is Edwin van der Sar?
q.e: The height of Edwin van der Sar is about 1.97 m. Edwin van der Sar (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɛtʋɪɱ vɑn dər ˈsɑr]; born 29 October 1970) is a Dutch football executive and former player.

q.p: About how tall is Petr Čech?
q.e: The height of Petr Čech is about 1.96 m. In his eleven-year spell at Chelsea, Čech made 494 appearances in all competitions, making him their seventh most capped player of all time.

q.p: About how tall is Benjamin Šeško?
q.e: The height of Benjamin Šeško is about 1.95 m.

q.p: Who founded Red Bull Powertrains?
q.e: Red Bull Powertrains: Dietrich Mateschitz. Red Bull Powertrains Limited (RBPT) is a Formula One power unit manufacturing company owned by the Austrian Red Bull GmbH and based in the United Kingdom.

q.p: Who founded Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.?
q.e: Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.: John Jackson. Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club, commonly referred to as Brighton, is a professional football club based in Brighton and Hove, East Sussex, England.

q.p: Who created Sambo?
q.e: Sambo (martial art): Anatoly Kharlampiyev. Sambo is a recognized style of amateur wrestling governed by the UWW in the World Wrestling Championships along with Greco-Roman wrestling and freestyle wrestling.

q.p: Who created 24 Hours of Le Mans?
q.e: 24 Hours of Le Mans: Automobile Club de l'Ouest. Unlike fixed-distance races whose winner is determined by minimum time, the 24 Hours of Le Mans is won by the car that covers the greatest distance in 24 hours.

q.p: In which country is Primera Federación?
q.e: Primera Federación: Spain. It is administered by the Royal Spanish Football Federation.

q.p: In which country is Steve Bartman incident?
q.e: Steve Bartman incident: United States. The play involved multiple spectators attempting to catch a fly ball and potentially affecting the outcome of the game.

q.p: In which country did the 1998 FIFA World Cup take place?
q.e: 1998 FIFA World Cup: France. The 1998 FIFA World Cup was the 16th FIFA World Cup, the football world championship for men's national teams.

q.p: In which country is VfL Wolfsburg based?
q.e: VfL Wolfsburg: Germany. V., commonly known as VfL Wolfsburg (pronounced [ˌfaʊ ʔɛf ʔɛl ˈvɔlfsbʊɐ̯k]), is a German professional sports club based in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony.

q.p: In which country is Defensa y Justicia based?
q.e: Defensa y Justicia: Argentina. The senior squad currently plays in the Primera División, the top division of the Argentine football league system.

q.p: In which country is 2021–22 Serie A?
q.e: 2021–22 Serie A: Italy. AC Milan won the title after defeating Sassuolo 3–0 at the Mapei Stadium – Città del Tricolore on 22 May 2022, the final matchday of the season.

q.p: In which country is Bayer 04 Leverkusen based?
q.e: Bayer 04 Leverkusen: Germany. It competes in the Bundesliga, the top tier of German football, and plays its home matches at the BayArena.

q.p: In which country is 2021 NFL season?
q.e: 2021 NFL season: United States. The 2021 NFL season was the 102nd season of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: In which country is 1. FC Köln based?
q.e: 1. FC Köln: Germany. FC Köln (German pronunciation: [ɛf ˈt͡seː ˈkœln]) or FC Cologne in English, is a German professional football club based in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia.

q.p: In which country was WrestleMania 38?
q.e: WrestleMania 38: United States. WrestleMania 38 was a 2022 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE.

q.p: In which country is 1. FSV Mainz 05 based?
q.e: 1. FSV Mainz 05: Germany. Mainz 05 play in the Bundesliga, the top tier of the German football league system, having most recently been promoted ahead of the 2009–10 season.

q.p: In which country is 2021–22 NBA season?
q.e: 2021–22 NBA season: United States. The 2021–22 NBA season was the 76th season of the National Basketball Association (NBA).

q.p: In which country did the World Chess Championship 2023 take place?
q.e: World Chess Championship 2023: Kazakhstan. The World Chess Championship 2023 was a chess match between Ian Nepomniachtchi and Ding Liren to determine the new World Chess Champion.

q.p: In which country was Royal Rumble (2022)?
q.e: Royal Rumble (2022): United States. The 2022 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE.

q.p: In which country is 2022 Finalissima?
q.e: 2022 Finalissima: United Kingdom. The match featured Italy, winners of UEFA Euro 2020 (held in 2021), and Argentina, winners of the 2021 Copa América.

q.p: In which country did the 2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament take place?
q.e: 2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament: United States. ASUN champion Kennesaw State made its NCAA tournament debut, while Southern Conference champion Furman made its first NCAA appearance since 1980.

q.p: In which country did the 2021–22 NFL playoffs take place?
q.e: 2021–22 NFL playoffs: United States. Of the 13 games played in the playoffs, nine were decided by seven or fewer points.

q.p: In which country is 2022–23 Serie A based?
q.e: 2022–23 Serie A: Italy. It was the first time since Roma in 2001 that a club other than AC Milan, Inter Milan or Juventus had won the Serie A title.

q.p: In which country did the 2022–23 Copa del Rey take place?
q.e: 2022–23 Copa del Rey: Spain. For Madrid, this was their twentieth Copa del Rey title, and first since 2014.

q.p: In which country is Como 1907 based?
q.e: Como 1907: Italy. Como 1907 (Italian pronunciation: [ˈkɔːmo]) is an Italian professional football club based in Como, Lombardy.

q.p: In which country did the 2022–23 FA Cup take place?
q.e: 2022–23 FA Cup: United Kingdom. The 2022–23 FA Cup was the 142nd edition of the oldest football tournament in the world, the Football Association Challenge Cup.

q.p: Which country is 2023 NASCAR Cup Series from?
q.e: 2023 NASCAR Cup Series: United States. The 2023 NASCAR Cup Series was the 75th season for NASCAR professional stock car racing in the United States and the 52nd season for the modern-era Cup Series.

q.p: In which country is 2022–23 Ligue 1?
q.e: 2022–23 Ligue 1: France. The 2022–23 Ligue 1, also known as Ligue 1 Uber Eats for sponsorship reasons, was the 85th season of the Ligue 1, France's premier football competition.

q.p: In which country was WrestleMania XL?
q.e: WrestleMania XL: United States. WrestleMania XL was a 2024 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE.

q.p: In which country did the 2023 Ashes series take place?
q.e: 2023 Ashes series: United Kingdom. The five-match series was a part of the 2023–2025 ICC World Test Championship, the venues being Edgbaston, Lord's, Headingley, Old Trafford and The Oval.

q.p: In which country did the AEW Revolution (2023) take place?
q.e: AEW Revolution (2023): United States. The 2023 Revolution was the fourth annual Revolution professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW).

q.p: In which country did the 2023 Copa do Brasil take place?
q.e: 2023 Copa do Brasil: Brazil. The 2023 Copa do Brasil (officially the Copa Betano do Brasil 2023 for sponsorship reasons) was the 35th edition of the Copa do Brasil football competition.

q.p: In which country is UFC 286?
q.e: UFC 286: United Kingdom.

q.p: In which country is UFC on ESPN: Vera vs. Sandhagen?
q.e: UFC on ESPN: Vera vs. Sandhagen: United States.

q.p: In which country was NXT Stand & Deliver (2023)?
q.e: NXT Stand & Deliver (2023): United States. The 2023 NXT Stand & Deliver was a professional wrestling event produced by WWE.

q.p: In which country is 2023 NCAA Division I FBS football season?
q.e: 2023 NCAA Division I FBS football season: United States. The regular season began on August 26 and ended on December 9.

q.p: In which country is 2022–23 NFL playoffs?
q.e: 2022–23 NFL playoffs: United States.

q.p: Which country is Kings League from?
q.e: Kings League: Spain. The Kings League is a seven-a-side football format established in 2022 by former football player Gerard Piqué.

q.p: In which country is UFC Fight Night: Pavlovich vs. Blaydes?
q.e: UFC Fight Night: Pavlovich vs. Blaydes: United States.

q.p: In which country was Backlash (2023) based?
q.e: Backlash (2023): United States. The 2023 Backlash was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE.

q.p: In which country did the 2023 Stanley Cup playoffs take place?
q.e: 2023 Stanley Cup playoffs: United States. The 2023 Stanley Cup playoffs was the playoff tournament of the National Hockey League (NHL) for the 2022–23 season.

q.p: In which country is All In (2023)?
q.e: All In (2023): United Kingdom. It was the first edition of All In produced by AEW and second overall after the independently-held inaugural All In event in September 2018.

q.p: In which country is 2023 WWE Draft based?
q.e: 2023 WWE Draft: United States. The 2023 WWE Draft was the 17th WWE Draft produced by the American professional wrestling promotion WWE between their Raw and SmackDown brand divisions.

q.p: In which country is Jai alai?
q.e: Jai alai: Spain. The term jai alai, coined by Serafin Baroja in 1875, is also often loosely applied to the fronton (the walled playing-area).

q.p: In which country did the National Football League take place?
q.e: National Football League: United States. Composed of 32 teams, it is divided equally between the American Football Conference (AFC) and the National Football Conference (NFC).

q.p: In which country did the Racing de Santander based take place?
q.e: Racing de Santander: Spain. It was founded in 1913 and it holds home games at El Sardinero, with a capacity for 22,222 spectators.

q.p: In which country is Elimination Chamber (2024) based?
q.e: Elimination Chamber (2024): Australia. This was WWE's first event to be held in Australia since Super Show-Down in October 2018, and the company's only event in the Asia–Pacific region in 2024.

q.p: In which country is Ars et Labor Ferrara Calcio based?
q.e: Ars et Labor Ferrara Calcio: Italy. Ars et Labor Ferrara, formerly known as SPAL, is a professional football club based in Ferrara, Emilia-Romagna, Italy.

q.p: In which country is 2. Bundesliga?
q.e: 2. Bundesliga: Germany. Bundesliga (Zweite Bundesliga [ˈtsvaɪtə ˈbʊndəsˌliːɡa]; lit. '2nd Federal League') is the second division of professional football in Germany.

q.p: In which country is Catalonia national football team based?
q.e: Catalonia national football team: Spain. The Catalonia national football team (Catalan: Selecció de futbol de Catalunya) is the official football team representing Catalonia.

q.p: In which country is National League (English football)?
q.e: National League (English football): United Kingdom. The National League is one of the major professional sports leagues in England and is the highest tier of Non-League football in England.

q.p: Which country is 24 Hours of Le Mans based from?
q.e: 24 Hours of Le Mans: France. Unlike fixed-distance races whose winner is determined by minimum time, the 24 Hours of Le Mans is won by the car that covers the greatest distance in 24 hours.

q.p: In which country is Brighton & Hove Albion F.C. based?
q.e: Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.: United Kingdom. Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club, commonly referred to as Brighton, is a professional football club based in Brighton and Hove, East Sussex, England.

q.p: In which country is Pencak silat?
q.e: Pencak silat: Netherlands. In neighbouring countries, the term usually refers to professional competitive silat.

q.p: In which country did the Hong Kong national football team take place?
q.e: Hong Kong national football team: People's Republic of China. Hong Kong had never qualified for the FIFA World Cup.

q.p: In which country is Canadian football?
q.e: Canadian football: Canada. Canadian and American football have shared origins and are closely related, but have some major differences.

q.p: In which country is Independiente del Valle based?
q.e: Independiente del Valle: Ecuador. In the 2013 Serie A season Independiente finished runners-up and they won their first league title in 2021.

q.p: In which country is Al Ahli SC (Doha) based?
q.e: Al Ahli SC (Doha): Qatar. Al Ahli SC (Arabic: النادي الأهلي الرياضي), also known as Al Ahli Doha, is a Qatari multi-sport club based in Doha.

q.p: In which country is Étoile Sportive du Sahel based?
q.e: Étoile Sportive du Sahel: Tunisia. The club is currently playing in the Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1, the Tunisian top-flight football league.

q.p: In which country is Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah)?
q.e: Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah): Saudi Arabia. Ittihad matches are played at Jeddah's main stadium King Abdullah Sports City, which is the second-largest stadium in Saudi Arabia, accommodating 66,345 spectators.

q.p: In which country is American Samoa national football team?
q.e: American Samoa national football team: United States. American Samoa's home ground is the Pago Park Soccer Stadium in Pago Pago.

q.p: In which country is FK Bodø/Glimt based?
q.e: FK Bodø/Glimt: Norway. The club currently plays in Eliteserien, the Norwegian top division.

q.p: In which country did the Copa del Rey take place?
q.e: Copa del Rey: Spain. The competition was founded in 1903, making it the oldest Spanish football competition played at a national level.

q.p: In which country is NBA draft?
q.e: NBA draft: United States. The NBA consists of 30 teams, and all thirty have at least one draft pick throughout the two draft rounds.

q.p: In which country is Klaksvíkar Ítróttarfelag based?
q.e: Klaksvíkar Ítróttarfelag: Faroe Islands. The club wears blue and white and plays matches at the Við Djúpumýrar stadium.

q.p: In which country is Ski jumping?
q.e: Ski jumping: Norway. Ski jumping is a winter sport in which competitors aim to achieve the farthest jump after sliding down on their skis from a specially designed curved ramp.

q.p: In which country is İstanbul Başakşehir F.K. based?
q.e: İstanbul Başakşehir F.K.: Turkey.

q.p: In which country was Deportivo de A Coruña based?
q.e: Deportivo de A Coruña: Spain. The club have also won the Spanish Cup twice (1994–95 and 2001–02), three Spanish Super Cups (1995, 2000 and 2002), and the now defunct Concurso España (1912).

q.p: The shortest common outdoor sprint distance in track and field, this race has been run at the Olympics since 1896 for men and since 1928 for women — name the event?
q.e: 100 metres is a sprint race in track and field competitions. The shortest common outdoor running distance, the 100-metre (109.36 yd) dash is one of the most popular and prestigious events in the sport of athletics.

q.p: In its 133rd season, sponsored partly by a crypto exchange, this top flight of Argentine football crowned River Plate champions for the 38th time — what competition is it?
q.e: 2023 AFA Liga Profesional de Fútbol (officially the Torneo Binance 2023, until the 26th round, for sponsorship reasons) was the 133rd season of top-flight professional football in Argentina.

q.p: Held in Belgrade, Serbia in September 2023, this competition doubled as a qualifier distributing 90 quota spots for the following year's Summer Olympics — name the event?
q.e: 2023 World Wrestling Championships was held from 16 to 24 September 2023 in Belgrade, Serbia.

q.p: Run in staggered lanes for exactly one lap of a standard outdoor track, this Olympic sprint event has been contested by men since 1896 and by women since 1964 — name the event?
q.e: 400 metres is a sprint event in track and field competitions.

q.p: Widely regarded as the best of her generation, this Las Vegas Aces star won three straight SEC Player of the Year awards at South Carolina — who is she?
q.e: A'ja Wilson (born August 8, 1996) is an American professional basketball player for the Las Vegas Aces of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).

q.p: This NFL wide receiver made the Pro Bowl with the Tennessee Titans before being traded to the Philadelphia Eagles in 2022, and now plays for the New England Patriots — who is he?
q.e: A. J. Brown (born June 30, 1997) is an American professional football wide receiver for the New England Patriots of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: This American sports analyst and former linebacker was drafted fifth overall by the Green Bay Packers in 2006 and later won Super Bowl XLV with the team — who is he?
q.e: A. J. Hawk (born January 6, 1984) is an American sports analyst and former professional football linebacker who played for 11 seasons in the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: Formed by a 1927 merger, this football club based in the Italian capital has won Serie A three times and lifted the inaugural UEFA Conference League in 2022 — name the club?
q.e: AS Roma (Rome Sport Association; Italian) is a professional football club based in Rome, Italy.

q.p: Drafted in the fourth round over off-field concerns, this Patriots tight end paired with Rob Gronkowski before his conviction for the murder of Odin Lloyd. Who was he?
q.e: Aaron Hernandez (November 6, 1989 - April 19, 2017) was an American professional football player who was a tight end in the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: Standing 6 feet 7 inches tall, this Yankees right fielder set the American League single-season home run record with 62 dingers — who is he?
q.e: Aaron Judge (born April 26, 1992) is an American professional baseball right fielder for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB).

q.p: This Welsh former midfielder became the youngest-ever first-team player at his boyhood Cardiff club before a £5 million move to Arsenal, and now manages Oxford United — who is he?
q.e: Aaron Ramsey (born 26 December 1990) is a Welsh football manager and former professional footballer who played as a midfielder.

q.p: Though born in England, this right-back plays international football for DR Congo, and moved from Crystal Palace to Manchester United for £50 million in 2019 — who is he?
q.e: Aaron Wan-Bissaka (born 26 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United.

q.p: With 184 international goals, this American forward ranks second on the all-time list across any gender and was named FIFA World Player of the Year in 2012 — who is she?
q.e: Abby Wambach (born June 2, 1980) is an American former professional soccer player who played as a forward.

q.p: Signed to Real American Freestyle, this Russian grappler is a two-time Olympic champion widely regarded as one of the greatest freestyle wrestlers ever — who is he?
q.e: Abdulrashid Sadulaev (born 9 May 1996) is a Russian freestyle wrestler who competes at 92 kilograms and formerly at 97 and 86 kilograms.

q.p: He won the 1960 Rome Olympic marathon running barefoot, then defended his title in Tokyo — both times in world-record time; which Ethiopian runner was it?
q.e: Abebe Bikila (August 7, 1932 - October 25, 1973) was an Ethiopian marathon runner who was a back-to-back Olympic marathon champion.

q.p: After rising through Real Madrid Castilla, this right-back captured a Serie A title with Inter Milan and now captains his national team. Who is he?
q.e: Achraf Hakimi (born 4 November 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and captains the Morocco national team.

q.p: This English winger came through Middlesbrough's academy, debuting at just 17 in a UEFA Cup match, before loan spells at Leeds and Watford — who is he?
q.e: Adam Johnson (footballer) (born 14 July 1987) is an English former professional footballer who played as a winger.

q.p: Having come through Southampton's academy after starting out at Bournemouth, this English midfielder later spent four seasons at Brighton before retiring in 2025 — who is he?
q.e: Adam Lallana (l-; born 10 May 1988) is an English professional football coach and former player who played as an attacking midfielder.

q.p: Beginning at Barcelona's reserves before spells at Aston Villa, Middlesbrough and Wolverhampton Wanderers, this Spanish winger most recently played for West Ham United — who is he?
q.e: Adama Traoré (footballer, born 1996) (born 25 January 1996) is a Spanish professional footballer who most recently played as a right winger for West Ham United.

q.p: After signing a four-year deal with Valencia in 2011, this French defender was immediately loaned back to the Ligue 1 club where he'd won a domestic double — who is he?
q.e: Adil Rami (born 27 December 1985) is a French former professional footballer who played as a centre-back.

q.p: This French tennis player reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 17 in 2024 and has won five ATP Tour titles, three on hardcourts and two on grass — who is he?
q.e: Adrian Mannarino (born 29 June 1988) is a French professional tennis player.

q.p: Prolific at Parma, this Romanian striker banged in 39 goals in three seasons before his big-money Chelsea switch in 2003 — who is he?
q.e: Adrian Mutu (Romanian; born 8 January 1979) is a Romanian professional football manager and former player.

q.p: Nicknamed 'L'Imperatore' for his prolific scoring at Parma and Inter Milan, this Brazilian striker was a two-time top-10 Ballon d'Or finalist in the mid-2000s. Who is he?
q.e: Adriano (footballer, born February 1982) (born 17 February 1982) is a Brazilian former professional footballer.

q.p: This French midfielder won five league titles at his boyhood Paris club before a free transfer to Juventus and a later move to AC Milan — who is he?
q.e: Adrien Rabiot (French; born 3 April 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club AC Milan and the France national team.

q.p: With 110 caps, this Nigerian winger became his country's most capped player and won a Saudi league title with Al Nassr in 2019 — who is he?
q.e: Ahmed Musa (born 14 October 1992) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Nigeria Premier Football League club Kano Pillars.

q.p: This NFL defensive end for the Detroit Lions was a Heisman Trophy runner-up at Michigan before going second overall in the 2022 draft and later making the Pro Bowl — who is he?
q.e: Aidan Hutchinson (born August 9, 2000) is an American professional football defensive end for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: This NFL quarterback played college football at Purdue before being drafted in the fourth round of 2023 by the Las Vegas Raiders. Who is he?
q.e: Aidan O'Connell (born September 1, 1998) is an American professional football quarterback for the Las Vegas Raiders of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: Reaching a career-high singles ranking of world No. 32 in 2023, this Croatian-Australian tennis player also won a junior Grand Slam doubles title back in 2009 — who is she?
q.e: Ajla Tomljanović (born 7 May 1993) is a Croatian-Australian professional tennis player.

q.p: Founded in Doha in 1952 and playing in a 44,400-seat stadium, this football club racked up seventeen major trophies during its 1980s and '90s heyday and wears red — which club?
q.e: Al-Arabi SC (Qatar) is a Qatari sports club based in the capital city Doha.

q.p: Nicknamed 'Al-Burtuqali' for their orange-and-blue colors, this Saudi Pro League club won the King's Cup for the first time in 2022 — which club?
q.e: Al-Fayha Club is a professional football club based in Al-Majma'ah, that plays in the Saudi Pro League, the first tier of Saudi football.

q.p: Based at the Ahmad bin Ali Stadium in Qatar, this club fields teams in football, handball, basketball, and swimming, with football drawing the most fan attention — which club?
q.e: Al-Rayyan SC is a Qatari multi-sports club fielding teams in a number of sports such as football, futsal, basketball, volleyball, handball, athletics, table tennis, and swimming.

q.p: This Saudi Pro League side, whose name means 'cooperation' in Arabic, is based in Buraidah and contests the Qassim Derby against its city rival — which club?
q.e: Al Taawoun FC is a Saudi Arabian professional football and multi-sports club based in Buraidah, Saudi Arabia, that competes in the Saudi Pro League, the top tier of the Saudi football league system.

q.p: Which Mecca-based Saudi club plays in the Saudi First Division League, the second tier of the country's football pyramid?
q.e: Al Wehda FC is a Saudi Arabian professional association football club based in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, that competes in the Saudi First Division League, the second tier of the Saudi football league system.

q.p: This English striker holds the Premier League's all-time goalscoring record with 260 goals and was one of the first two players inducted into its Hall of Fame in 2021 — who is he?
q.e: Alan Shearer (born 13 August 1970) is an English football pundit and former professional player who played as a striker.

q.p: Captaining England in 59 Tests and retiring in 2018, this opening batsman is England's second-highest Test run scorer of all time -- who is he?
q.e: Alastair Cook (born 25 December 1984) is an English commentator and a former cricketer and captain of the England Test and One-Day International (ODI) cricket teams.

q.p: Between 2007 and 2011 this Spanish rider won six consecutive Grand Tours he entered, becoming one of only two cyclists ever to win all three multiple times — who is he?
q.e: Alberto Contador (Spanish; born 6 December 1982) is a Spanish former professional cyclist.

q.p: Before his WWE run, this Mexican wrestler and MMA fighter competed as Dos Caras Jr., later becoming the first Mexican-born WWE world champion — who is he?
q.e: Alberto Del Rio (born 25 May 1977) is a Mexican professional wrestler, professional wrestling promoter, sports commentator, and mixed martial artist.

q.p: Born in 2003, this Spanish left-back has established himself for both a storied Catalan club and the Spain national team — who is he?
q.e: Alejandro Balde (born 18 October 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

q.p: This Spanish tennis player reached a career-high ATP ranking of world No. 14 in 2025, currently sitting as Spain's No. 2 men's singles player — who is he?
q.e: Alejandro Davidovich Fokina (born 5 June 1999) is a Spanish professional tennis player.

q.p: He joined Manchester United's academy from Atlético Madrid, won the FA Youth Cup, and debuted for the first team at just 17 — which young winger, now at Chelsea, is it?
q.e: Alejandro Garnacho (born 1 July 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Chelsea.

q.p: A Serbian striker born in 1994 who was named among top talents under 19 at age 18, now captains the Serbia national team — who plays for Al Rayyan?
q.e: Aleksandar Mitrović (Serbian; born 16 September 1994) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Qatar Stars League club Al Rayyan and captains the Serbia national team.

q.p: Renowned for his passing, pace, and versatility, this Italy international anchors the back line for Serie A giants Inter Milan — who is he?
q.e: Alessandro Bastoni (born 13 April 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays primarily as a centre-back for Serie A club Inter Milan and the Italy national team.

q.p: This AC Milan stalwart scored in his final match before retiring at 41 in 2007, having won 7 Serie A titles and 5 European Cups — who is he?
q.e: Alessandro Costacurta (born 24 April 1966) is an Italian former professional footballer who played as a defender.

q.p: Now a Sky Sport Italia pundit, this creative Italian forward scored 346 career goals — second only to one countryman — and won Serie A's player award in 1998 and 2008. Who is he?
q.e: Alessandro Del Piero (Italian; born 9 November 1974) is an Italian former professional footballer who mainly played as a second striker, although he was capable of playing in several offensive positions.

q.p: Regarded as one of the greatest defenders in football history, this Italian centre-back made over 400 Serie A appearances and now coaches Serie B club Avellino — who is he?
q.e: Alessandro Nesta (Italian; born 19 March 1976) is an Italian professional football coach and former player who played as a centre-back, currently the head coach of Serie B club Avellino.

q.p: This Thai-British Formula One driver races under the Thai flag for Williams, and is the son of an English racing driver and the nephew of another — who is he?
q.e: Alex Albon (born 23 March 1996) is a Thai and British racing driver who competes under the Thai flag in Formula One for Williams.

q.p: Nicknamed 'Fergie' and credited for the 'Class of '92,' this Scot won more trophies than any manager in football history during his 27 years at Manchester United — who is he?
q.e: Alex Ferguson (born 31 December 1941), also known by the nickname Fergie, is a Scottish former professional football manager and player, best known for managing Manchester United from 1986 to 2013.

q.p: Named Young Player of the Year in 2012, this English centre-back first captained her country's senior side at the 2023 Arnold Clark Cup — who is she?
q.e: Alex Greenwood (born 7 September 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays for Women's Super League club Manchester City, whom she captains, and the England national team.

q.p: This English midfielder became the youngest English goalscorer in Champions League history after joining Arsenal from Southampton in 2011 as a 17-year-old prospect — who is he?
q.e: Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain (born 15 August 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Celtic.

q.p: This Brazilian fighter and former kickboxer became just the ninth person in UFC history to win championships in two different weight divisions — who is he?
q.e: Alex Pereira (born 7 July 1987) is a Brazilian professional mixed martial artist and former professional kickboxer.

q.p: Nicknamed "A-Rod," this shortstop-turned-third-baseman starred for the Mariners, Rangers and Yankees over 22 seasons before buying into the NBA's Timberwolves — who is he?
q.e: Alex Rodriguez (born July 27, 1975), nicknamed "A-Rod", is an American former professional baseball shortstop and third baseman and current businessman.

q.p: Voted the best left-back in Brazil's top flight in his first season at Grêmio, this defender later won trophies at Galatasaray before returning home — who is he?
q.e: Alex Telles (Brazilian; born 15 December 1992) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Srie A club Botafogo and the Brazil national team.

q.p: A three-time world Combat Sambo champion in the absolute division, this Russian mixed martial artist is the younger brother of a more famous fighting sibling — who is he?
q.e: Alexander Emelianenko (or Yemelianenko; born 2 August 1981) is a Russian professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: This Swedish fighter became a perennial UFC light heavyweight title contender, challenging for the belt on three separate occasions — who is he?
q.e: Alexander Gustafsson (born 15 January 1987) is a Swedish professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: After spells at Borussia Dortmund and Real Sociedad, this Swedish striker joined Newcastle for a club-record fee in 2022 before his record-breaking move to Liverpool — who is he?
q.e: Alexander Isak (Swedish; born 21 September 1999) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Liverpool and the Sweden national team.

q.p: Nicknamed "the Great 8," this Russian left winger and Capitals captain became the only player in NHL history to score 900 regular-season goals — who is he?
q.e: Alexander Ovechkin (born 17 September 1985) is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a left winger and captain for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL).

q.p: Nicknamed "Sascha," this German once ranked world No. 2 and owns a Tokyo Olympic gold plus two ATP Finals crowns — which player is it?
q.e: Alexander Zverev (German; born 20 April 1997) is a German professional tennis player and the current world No.

q.p: This series of fantasy comedy novels by Terry Pratchett is set on a flat planet balanced on the backs of four elephants, who in turn stand on a giant turtle. What is it?
q.e: Alexandre Pantoja (born April 16, 1990) is a Brazilian professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: Currently his country's number-two men's singles player, this Australian pro represents his nation in the Davis Cup and has won three ATP Tour titles — who is he?
q.e: Alexei Popyrin (born 5 August 1999) is an Australian professional tennis player.

q.p: Prized for his passing and versatility, this Argentina international plays in midfield for Liverpool — though he was once loaned to Boca Juniors. Who is he?
q.e: Alexis Mac Allister (Spanish; born 24 December 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Argentina national team.

q.p: Knighted in 1967, this England manager guided his side to victory the previous year and later to third at the 1968 European Championship — who was he?
q.e: Alf Ramsey (22 January 1920 - 28 April 1999) was an English football player and manager.

q.p: This Iranian midfielder began at Fath Tehran in 1996, won two league titles with Persepolis, then starred in Germany's Bundesliga during an 18-year career — who is he?
q.e: Ali Karimi (born 8 November 1978) is an Iranian football coach and former professional player.

q.p: This German runner helped her national team place second in the 4×400m relay at the 2017 European U20 Championships, then third at the U23s in 2019 — who is she?
q.e: Alica Schmidt (German; born 8 November 1998) is a German runner.

q.p: In the 2017-18 Eredivisie season, this Iranian winger scored 21 league goals to become the first Asian player ever to top the scoring charts in a major European league. Who is he?
q.e: Alireza Jahanbakhsh (born 11 August 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Iran national team.

q.p: A forward for the Switzerland national team, she also turns out in England's WSL for Leicester City. Who is she?
q.e: Alisha Lehmann (born 21 January 1999) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a forward for WSL club Leicester City and the Switzerland national team.

q.p: This American mixed martial artist became the first UFC champion in history to win a title by disqualification. Who is he?
q.e: Aljamain Sterling (born July 31, 1989) is an American professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: An 11-time All-Star who took home All-Star Game MVP honors in both 2001 and 2005, this guard earned the league MVP in 2001 — who is he?
q.e: Allen Iverson (born June 7, 1975) is an American former professional basketball player.

q.p: With 260 goals for two clubs between 1983 and 2001, this Scottish forward ranks fifth on the all-time scoring list for the country's top football tier — who is he?
q.e: Ally McCoist (born 24 September 1962) is a Scottish former footballer who has since worked as a manager and TV pundit.

q.p: This Turkish goalkeeper began his career at Ankaragücü, made 145 appearances for Fenerbahçe, and signed with Manchester United in 2023 — who is he?
q.e: Altay Bayındır (born 14 April 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester United and the Turkey national team.

q.p: This Premier League defensive midfielder for Aston Villa was born in Senegal yet represents Belgium internationally — who is he?
q.e: Amadou Onana (born 16 August 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Aston Villa.

q.p: Widely regarded as one of the greatest female fighters ever, this Brazilian-American is the only woman to become a two-division UFC champion. Who is she?
q.e: Amanda Nunes (born May 30, 1988) is a Brazilian-American professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: Captaining India's Under-19 team at the 2004 Youth World Cup before becoming the only player besides Rohit Sharma to win the IPL six times, who is this middle-order batsman?
q.e: Ambati Rayudu (born 23 September 1985) is a former Indian international cricketer, commentator and politician.

q.p: This forward-slash-winger, though born in France, chose to represent Morocco at international level and turns out for Bournemouth in the Premier League — who is he?
q.e: Amine Adli (born 10 May 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder, winger, or forward for Premier League club Bournemouth.

q.p: Famous for a powerful one-handed backhand, this French former world No. 1 won an Olympic silver medal in 2004 before retiring in 2009 to become a coach — who is she?
q.e: Amélie Mauresmo (French; born 5 July 1979) is a French former professional tennis player, tennis coach, and tournament director.

q.p: Becoming the first Korean woman to claim a world singles badminton title in 2023, this player added Olympic and Asian Games gold along the way — who is she?
q.e: An Se-young (born 5 February 2002) is a South Korean badminton player, who won the gold medal at the 2024 Summer Olympics in the women's singles event.

q.p: This Mexican professional wrestler, signed to AEW, also appears for NJPW as a member of the United Empire stable — name his ring persona?
q.e: Andrade El Idolo (born November 3, 1989) is a Mexican professional wrestler.

q.p: This NBA center was a top-rated high school prospect in 2011, played one college season for UConn, and was drafted ninth overall by the Detroit Pistons in 2012 — who is he?
q.e: Andre Drummond (born August 10, 1993) is an American professional basketball player for the New York Knicks of the National Basketball Association (NBA).

q.p: This American former NBA swingman played 19 seasons, made the All-Star team in 2012, and won four championships with Golden State, earning Finals MVP honors in 2015 — who is he?
q.e: Andre Iguodala (ig-w-; born January 28, 1984) is an American former professional basketball player who played for 19 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA).

q.p: This pound-for-pound great won Olympic light heavyweight gold in 2004, then swept through the Super Six tournament to unify world titles as a professional — who is he?
q.e: Andre Ward (born February 23, 1984) is an American former professional boxer who competed from 2004 to 2017.

q.p: This versatile Italian defender, capable of playing full-back or wing-back, suits up for both Juventus and the Italy national team — who is he?
q.e: Andrea Cambiaso (born 20 February 2000) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a full-back or wing-back for Serie A club Juventus and the Italy national team.

q.p: A versatile attacking full-back known for his crossing, this German scored the winning penalty in the 1990 World Cup final against Argentina — who is he?
q.e: Andreas Brehme (German; 9 November 1960 - 20 February 2024) was a German professional football player and coach.

q.p: A former UFC Heavyweight Champion who later became a bare-knuckle boxer, this Belarusian-American fighter has also competed in Strikeforce and Affliction — who is he?
q.e: Andrei Arlovski is a Belarusian-American professional mixed martial artist, bare knuckle boxer, and actor.

q.p: This five-time All-Star outfielder was picked 11th overall by Pittsburgh in the 2005 draft and won a Gold Glove in 2012 — who is he?
q.e: Andrew McCutchen (born October 10, 1986) is an American professional baseball outfielder and designated hitter in the Atlanta Braves organization.

q.p: Quarterfinalist at all four majors and a 17-time tour singles champion, this Russian struck gold in mixed doubles at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics — who is he?
q.e: Andrey Rublev (born 20 October 1997) is a Russian professional tennis player.

q.p: This Ukrainian goalkeeper mans the net for both Real Madrid and his national team — who is he?
q.e: Andriy Lunin (born 11 February 1999) is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Ukraine national team.

q.p: This Ukrainian striker is the all-time top scorer for the Ukraine national team with 48 goals and is considered one of the greatest strikers ever. Who is he?
q.e: Andriy Shevchenko (born 29 September 1976) is a Ukrainian former football manager and player.

q.p: After breaking through at Tottenham, this English right winger spent five seasons at Crystal Palace before moving to Everton in 2021 — who is he?
q.e: Andros Townsend (born 16 July 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Thai League 1 club Kanchanaburi Power.

q.p: This French striker became Ligue 1's top scorer during the 2008–09 season with Toulouse before later starring for Liga MX club Tigres UANL — who is he?
q.e: André-Pierre Gignac (born 5 December 1985) is a French professional footballer who played as a striker for Liga MX club Tigres UANL.

q.p: Now anchoring midfield for Columbus Crew in MLS, this Portuguese international once won Euro 2016 and played for both Barcelona and Everton. Who is he?
q.e: André Gomes (Portuguese; born 30 July 1993) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew.

q.p: After joining Inter Milan on a free transfer in 2022, this Cameroon goalkeeper won a Coppa Italia and reached a Champions League final in a single season. Who is he?
q.e: André Onana (French; born 2 April 1996) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Sper Lig club Trabzonspor, on loan from Premier League club Manchester United, and the Cameroon national team.

q.p: Capped 57 times for Germany and part of the victorious 2014 World Cup squad, this winger set up the extra-time winner in the final — which player?
q.e: André Schürrle (German; born 6 November 1990) is a German former professional footballer who played as a winger or forward.

q.p: After scoring 28 goals in one record-breaking Bundesliga season for Eintracht Frankfurt, this Portuguese striker moved to RB Leipzig for a reported €23 million — who is he?
q.e: André Silva (footballer, born 1995) (European; born 6 November 1995) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Primeira Liga club Porto.

q.p: After a title-winning stint in the Netherlands, this Mexican international closed out his career with 218 appearances for a Spanish club before retiring in 2025 — who is he?
q.e: Andrés Guardado (Spanish; born 28 September 1986) is a Mexican former professional footballer who played as a midfielder.

q.p: Spanish midfielder who spent most of his career at Barcelona and is widely regarded as one of the greatest midfielders ever—known for balance, control, and agility—who?
q.e: Andrés Iniesta (Spanish; born 11 May 1984) is a Spanish football coach and former professional footballer who is the manager of UAE First Division League club Gulf United FC.

q.p: This English striker joined Manchester United for a British record transfer fee from Newcastle, then won nine trophies in six years there, including the 1999 Treble — who is he?
q.e: Andy Cole (born 15 October 1971) is an English former professional footballer who played as a striker.

q.p: A former rugby league star for Wigan who twice won the Man of Steel award, he switched codes and now coaches the Ireland national rugby union team — who is he?
q.e: Andy Farrell (born 30 May 1975) is an English professional rugby union coach and former rugby league and rugby union footballer.

q.p: Calling himself an 'anti-comedian' who never told a joke, this performance artist promised only to entertain, not to make audiences laugh in any traditional sense — who is he?
q.e: Andy Kaufman (January 17, 1949 - May 16, 1984) was an American entertainer and performance artist.

q.p: This British tennis great spent 41 weeks ranked world No. 1 and won two Olympic gold medals, yet finished runner-up at eight majors before finally lifting his own — who is he?
q.e: Andy Murray (born 15 May 1987) is a British former professional tennis player and coach.

q.p: This long-tenured NFL coach led the Philadelphia Eagles for 14 seasons and is the only coach to win 100 games with two different franchises — who is he?
q.e: Andy Reid (born March 19, 1958) is an American professional football coach who is the head coach for the Kansas City Chiefs of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: This American tennis player spent 13 weeks as world No. 1, winning the 2003 US Open as his lone major title among 32 ATP crowns, and led the U.S. to the 2007 Davis Cup — who is he?
q.e: Andy Roddick (born August 30, 1982) is an American former professional tennis player.

q.p: Winner of the 2016 Australian Open, US Open, and 2018 Wimbledon, this German claimed an Olympic silver in singles at the Rio Games — who is she?
q.e: Angelique Kerber (born 18 January 1988) is a German former professional tennis player.

q.p: This Spanish full-back, born José Ángel Esmorís Tasende, is known by a diminutive nickname and currently plays for Roma — who is he?
q.e: Angeliño (born 4 January 1997), known by the diminutive Angelio, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Roma.

q.p: Together with Lasith Malinga, who holds the record for the highest ninth-wicket partnership in ODI cricket, and led Sri Lanka to the 2014 Asia Cup title?
q.e: Angelo Mathews (born 2 June 1987) is a professional Sri Lankan cricketer and a former captain of the national cricket team in all formats.

q.p: Inspired as a boy by watching B.S. Chandrasekhar bowl, this Indian leg-spinner went on to claim 619 Test wickets over 132 matches and an 18-year international career — who is he?
q.e: Anil Kumble (born 17 October 1970) is a former Indian cricketer, captain, coach and commentator who played Test and One Day International cricket for his national team over an international career of 18 years.

q.p: This Russian tennis player won the 2016 Australian Open girls' doubles title at age 17 before rising to a career-high singles ranking of No. 11 in 2024 — who is she?
q.e: Anna Kalinskaya (born 2 December 1998) is a Russian professional tennis player.

q.p: This retired British tennis player turned television presenter once won an ITV celebrity wrestling contest and later finished fourth on Strictly Come Dancing. Who is she?
q.e: Annabel Croft (born 12 July 1966) is a British former professional tennis player and current radio and television presenter.

q.p: A forward and winger born in 2002, he chose to represent Spain despite his Guinea-Bissau birth — which young Monaco player is it?
q.e: Ansu Fati (born 31 October 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Ligue 1 club Monaco.

q.p: The first Canadian ever taken with the top pick in an NBA draft, this 2013 first-overall selection is often cited as the worst number-one pick in league history — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Bennett (basketball) (born March 14, 1993) is a Canadian professional basketball player for Al-Najma of the Bahraini Premier League.

q.p: Nicknamed "Ant-Man," this guard went first overall to the Timberwolves in the 2020 draft and grabbed Olympic gold in 2024 — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Edwards (basketball) (born August 5, 2001), nicknamed "Ant-Man" or simply "Ant", is an American professional basketball player for the Minnesota Timberwolves of the National Basketball Association (NBA).

q.p: Born in 2002, this Swedish forward plays on the wing for Newcastle United in the Premier League while also representing his national team — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Elanga (born 27 April 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Premier League club Newcastle United and the Sweden national team.

q.p: This English winger began his career at Everton, moved to Newcastle United in 2023, and then joined Spanish giants Barcelona in 2026 — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Gordon (footballer) (born 24 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays primarily as a winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the England national team.

q.p: Named Prospect of the Year a year after turning pro, this British heavyweight's career took off with a 2017 win over Wladimir Klitschko. Who is he?
q.e: Anthony Joshua (born 15 October 1989) is a British professional boxer.

q.p: This Australian actor won a Primetime Emmy for a recurring role on Frasier, then later won a Golden Globe for leading an American crime drama as an FBI agent — who is he?
q.e: Anthony LaPaglia (l-,; born 31 January 1959) is an Australian actor.

q.p: Signing for Manchester United in 2015 for a fee that made him the most expensive teenager in football history at the time, this French forward began his career at Lyon — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Martial (French; born 5 December 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward.

q.p: This American fighter competed across three UFC weight divisions and once held both a UFC and a defunct promotion's Lightweight title — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Pettis (born January 27, 1987) is an American professional mixed martial artist, and professional boxer.

q.p: Selected by the Yankees in the first round of the 2019 draft, this shortstop won the American League Gold Glove in his rookie season of 2023 — who is he?
q.e: Anthony Volpe (born April 28, 2001) is an American professional baseball shortstop for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB).

q.p: This French rugby scrum-half captains his national team and is the only player ever to win World Rugby's Player of the Year award in both the 15s and Sevens formats. Who is he?
q.e: Antoine Dupont (born 15 November 1996) is a French professional rugby union player who plays as a scrum-half for Top 14 club Toulouse and captains the France national team.

q.p: A French footballer born in 1991, he plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Atlético Madrid and is considered one of his generation's best players — who is he?
q.e: Antoine Griezmann (French; born 21 March 1991) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder who plays for La Liga club Atltico Madrid.

q.p: After loan spells at Livorno, Juventus, Parma and Cesena, this Italian right winger settled at Inter Milan in 2016, making over 150 appearances across four seasons — who is he?
q.e: Antonio Candreva (Italian; born 28 February 1987) is an Italian former professional footballer who played as a right midfielder or right winger.

q.p: Nicknamed 'the jewel of Old Bari' for his early promise, this flamboyant Italian forward became just as famous for his short temper as his silky skill — who is he?
q.e: Antonio Cassano (Italian; born 12 July 1982) is an Italian former professional footballer who played as a forward.

q.p: Born in 1977, this Italian forward scored 16 goals to help his club reach Serie A in 2001-02, then moved on to a long career at Udinese — who is he?
q.e: Antonio Di Natale (Italian; born 13 October 1977) is an Italian football coach and former professional player who played as a striker.

q.p: This American football coach led the Las Vegas Raiders in 2023 and 2024, after a playing career as a linebacker that included a Super Bowl win with the New York Giants — who is he?
q.e: Antonio Pierce (born October 26, 1978) is an American professional football coach and former linebacker.

q.p: Spending his entire senior career at Sevilla and winning five trophies there, this Spanish left-back died in 2007 after cardiac arrests during a match against Getafe — who was he?
q.e: Antonio Puerta (Spanish; 26 November 1984 - 28 August 2007) was a Spanish professional footballer who played solely for Sevilla.

q.p: This Dutch-born winger, born in May 1995, plays in the Qatar Stars League for Al-Sailiya — who is he?
q.e: Anwar El Ghazi (born 3 May 1995) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for Qatar Stars League club Al-Sailiya.

q.p: Ranked world No. 1 in both singles and doubles during her career, this Spanish tennis star won four Olympic medals and was crowned 1994 ITF World Champion of the Year — who is she?
q.e: Arantxa Sánchez Vicario (Spanish; born 18 December 1971) is a Spanish former professional tennis player.

q.p: This American college football quarterback for the Texas Longhorns belongs to one of the NFL's most storied football dynasties — who is he?
q.e: Arch Manning (born April 27, 2004) is an American college football quarterback for the Texas Longhorns.

q.p: Named from the Latin word for 'bow', this sport or skill involves shooting arrows at a target, with practitioners sometimes called toxophilites. Name the sport?
q.e: Archery is the sport, practice, or skill of using a bow to shoot arrows at a target.

q.p: This former NFL quarterback spent 14 seasons mostly with the New Orleans Saints and became the patriarch of a famous quarterback family, siring two future NFL passers — who is he?
q.e: Archie Manning (born May 19, 1949) is an American former professional football quarterback who played in the National Football League (NFL) for 14 seasons, primarily with the New Orleans Saints.

q.p: A teenage prodigy from Fenerbahçe who quickly won La Liga and the Champions League after moving to Real Madrid, he played a key role in Turkey's Euro 2024 run — who is he?
q.e: Arda Güler (Turkish; born 25 February 2005) is a Turkish professional footballer who primarily plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Turkey national team.

q.p: This teenage Bundesliga winger, born in Kosovo and holding a German passport, turns out for Bayern Munich's first team — who is he?
q.e: Arijon Ibrahimović (born 11 December 2005) is a German Kosovan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder and winger for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich.

q.p: First a player of the year at Groningen, this Dutch winger known for dribbling and long-range shots became the Netherlands' top Champions League assist provider — who is he?
q.e: Arjen Robben (Dutch; born 23 January 1984) is a Dutch former professional footballer who played as a winger.

q.p: Competing in the UFC's lightweight division, this Armenian-Russian mixed martial artist and freestyle wrestler ranked as high as #2 in his weight class in early 2026 — who is he?
q.e: Arman Tsarukyan is an Armenian and Russian professional mixed martial artist, submission grappler, and freestyle wrestler.

q.p: Born in England but capped internationally for Albania, this striker currently plays for EFL Championship side Burnley — who is he?
q.e: Armando Broja (Albanian; born 10 September 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship side Burnley.

q.p: Born in Nigeria but capped by the Netherlands national team, this left winger for La Liga club Valencia previously played for Club Brugge and AFC Bournemouth — who is he?
q.e: Arnaut Danjuma (born 31 January 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger for La Liga club Valencia.

q.p: After winning the Eerste Divisie as a player with PEC Zwolle and later guiding Feyenoord to a continental final, this Dutch coach became Liverpool's head coach — who is he?
q.e: Arne Slot (Dutch; born 17 September 1978) is a Dutch professional football manager and former player who was most recently the head coach of Premier League club Liverpool.

q.p: This British UFC featherweight, ranked #5 in the division as of June 2026, fights professionally in mixed martial arts — who is he?
q.e: Arnold Allen (born 22 January 1994) is a British professional mixed martial artist.

q.p: Based in Islington, north London, this club holds a record 14 FA Cups and once completed a top-flight season unbeaten — name the club?
q.e: Arsenal F.C. is an English professional football club based in Islington, North London, England.

q.p: Nicknamed "Le Professeur," this French manager became the longest-serving and most successful boss in his London club's history over 22 years in charge — who is he?
q.e: Arsène Wenger (born 22 October 1949) is a French former football manager and player who has been serving as FIFA's Chief of Global Football Development since 2019.

q.p: Born in 1997, this Ukrainian footballer plays as a striker for Serie A side Roma and for his national team — name this player?
q.e: Artem Dovbyk (born 21 June 1997) is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Roma and the Ukraine national team.

q.p: This Brazilian forward, born in April 1998, currently turns out for Série A side Botafogo — who is he?
q.e: Arthur Cabral (born 25 April 1998) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Srie A club Botafogo.

q.p: Born in June 2004, this French tennis player has already won four ATP Tour singles titles — who is he?
q.e: Arthur Fils (French; born 12 June 2004) is a French professional tennis player.

q.p: A former Ferrari Driver Academy member, this Monégasque racer climbed from Formula 3 through Formula 2 before claiming a 2024 Italian GT Endurance title — who is he?
q.e: Arthur Leclerc (French; born 14 October 2000) is a Mongasque racing driver who last competed in the GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup for AF Corse.

q.p: This Lithuanian center won an Olympic gold medal in 1988 playing for the Soviet Union, then spent seven seasons in the NBA after a legendary European career — who is he?
q.e: Arvydas Sabonis (Lithuanian; born 19 December 1964) is a Lithuanian former professional basketball player and businessman.

q.p: The current women's tennis world No. 1 from Belarus has won two Australian Opens and two US Opens—who is she?
q.e: Aryna Sabalenka (born 5 May 1998) is a Belarusian professional tennis player.

q.p: This French defensive midfielder anchors the back line and midfield alike for both Real Madrid and the French national team — who is he?
q.e: Aurélien Tchouaméni (French; born 27 January 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or a centre-back for La Liga club Real Madrid and the France national team.

q.p: This former Overtime Elite MVP, drafted fifth by Detroit in 2023, earned an All-Defensive First Team nod after leading the league in steals — which Pistons player?
q.e: Ausar Thompson (-SAR; born January 30, 2003) is an American professional basketball player for the Detroit Pistons of the National Basketball Association (NBA).

q.p: He played for the Wichita State Shockers and Oklahoma Sooners before signing with the Lakers as an undrafted free agent — which guard?
q.e: Austin Reaves (born May 29, 1998) is an American professional basketball player for the Los Angeles Lakers of the National Basketball Association (NBA).

q.p: This McDonald's All-American led his Florida high school to back-to-back state titles before being drafted 10th overall in 2012 by the Hornets — who is he?
q.e: Austin Rivers (born August 1, 1992) is an American former professional basketball player who is currently a sports analyst for ESPN and NBC Sports.

q.p: This WWE wrestler, part of The Vision stable, currently holds the World Tag Team Championship alongside stablemate Bron Breakker — name his ring persona?
q.e: Austin Theory (born August 2, 1997) is an American professional wrestler.

q.p: Born in California but raised in Arizona, this NHL center and captain has had his prolific goal-scoring compared to Alexander Ovechkin — who is he?
q.e: Auston Matthews (born September 17, 1997) is an American professional ice hockey player who is a center and captain for the Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League (NHL).

q.p: This French centre-back, born in 1998, currently plays in the Premier League for Chelsea — who is he?
q.e: Axel Disasi (born 11 March 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Chelsea.

q.p: This Belgian defensive midfielder began his career at hometown club Standard Liège, scoring 42 goals in 183 appearances and winning the Belgian Golden Shoe — who is he?
q.e: Axel Witsel (born 12 January 1989) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for the Belgium national team.

q.p: Racing for McLaren, this Brazilian driver won three Formula One World titles and held the record for most pole positions at the time of his death in 1994 — who was he?
q.e: Ayrton Senna (Brazilian; 21 March 1960 - 1 May 1994) was a Brazilian racing driver and philanthropist who competed in Formula One from 1984 to 1994.

q.p: A right-handed top-order batter, this Pakistani captained his country in all three formats and led Peshawar Zalmi in the PSL. Who is he?
q.e: Babar Azam (Urdu: محمد بابر اعظم; born 15 October 1994) is a Pakistani international cricketer and a former captain of the Pakistan national team in all three formats of the game.

q.p: Before becoming a home-run icon, this 'Sultan of Swat' starred as a left-handed pitcher for the Boston Red Sox during a 22-season MLB career — who is he?
q.e: Babe Ruth (February 6, 1895 - August 16, 1948) was an American professional baseball player whose career in Major League Baseball (MLB) spanned 22 seasons, from 1914 through 1935.

q.p: Held on May 6, 2023, at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico, this WWE pay-per-view was the promotion's first premium live event on the island since 2005 — name the event?
q.e: Backlash (2023) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE.

q.p: In this racquet sport, each side may strike the projectile only once before it crosses the net — and that projectile isn't a ball but a shuttlecock. Which sport?
q.e: Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.

q.p: After setting FBS records for passing yards and touchdowns at Western Kentucky, this quarterback was drafted in 2022 by the Patriots before backing up in Cleveland — who is he?
q.e: Bailey Zappe (born April 26, 1999) is an American professional football quarterback for the New York Jets of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: The first walk-on ever to win the Heisman, this quarterback went first overall to Cleveland in 2018 and now leads the Tampa Bay Buccaneers — who is he?
q.e: Baker Mayfield (born April 14, 1995) is an American professional football quarterback for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: This winter sport's rink can be nearly double the length of a hockey rink, and it has long been dominated internationally by Sweden and Russia - what is it?
q.e: Bandy is a winter sport and ball sport played by two teams wearing ice skates on a large ice surface (either indoors or outdoors) while using sticks to direct a ball into the opposing team's goal.

q.p: Ranked world No. 1 in doubles and No. 2 in singles, which Czech tennis star has racked up 12 combined major titles across singles, doubles, and mixed doubles?
q.e: Barbora Krejčíková (Czech; born 18 December 1995) is a Czech professional tennis player.

q.p: Which WWE SmackDown star, a two-time Golden Gloves boxing champion and former Colts and Cardinals lineman, won the Money in the Bank briefcase in 2017?
q.e: Baron Corbin (born September 13, 1984) is an American professional wrestler, Brazilian jiu jitsu practitioner, former professional football player and former amateur boxer.

q.p: This left fielder holds the single-season home run record of 73, set in 2001, plus a record seven NL MVP awards across stints with the Pirates and Giants — who is he?
q.e: Barry Bonds (born July 24, 1964) is an American former professional baseball left fielder who played 22 seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB).

q.p: At just 5-foot-8, this elusive Detroit Lions back led the NFL in rushing four times — after a college junior year of 2,628 yards and 37 touchdowns at Oklahoma State — who is he?
q.e: Barry Sanders (born July 16, 1968) is an American former professional football running back who played for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL) for 10 seasons.

q.p: This retired wrestler won WWF tag-team gold alongside his brother-in-law Mike Rotunda and later earned a second WWE Hall of Fame induction as part of the U.S. Express — who is he?
q.e: Barry Windham (born July 4, 1960) is an American retired professional wrestler.

q.p: Starting out as a wide midfielder before moving inside, this German spent 17 seasons at Bayern Munich and won a Champions League title there — who is he?
q.e: Bastian Schweinsteiger (born 1 August 1984) is a German former professional footballer who played as a midfielder.

q.p: This Brazilian tennis player became the first Brazilian woman to crack the WTA singles top 10 in the Open Era, reaching a major semifinal at the 2023 French Open — who is she?
q.e: Beatriz Haddad Maia (Brazilian; born 30 May 1996) is a Brazilian professional tennis player.

q.p: This All Blacks playmaker kicked nine points on his international debut against Ireland in 2012 and went on to win back-to-back World Rugby Player of the Year awards — who is he?
q.e: Beauden Barrett (born 27 May 1991) is a New Zealand rugby union player who plays as first five-eighth or fullback for the All Blacks, Blues and (formerly) Hurricanes in Super Rugby, and Taranaki in the Bunnings NPC.

q.p: A naturalized Russian citizen who won Olympic bronze with Russia's national team, this WNBA legend now heads the Las Vegas Aces as head coach — who is she?
q.e: Becky Hammon (born March 11, 1977) is an American-Russian professional basketball coach and former player who is the head coach of the Las Vegas Aces of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).

q.p: A French left-back who came through Le Havre's youth academy and played for Marseille and Monaco before moving on. Who is he?
q.e: Benjamin Mendy (French; born 17 July 1994) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ekstraklasa club Pogo Szczecin.

q.p: This French defender for Marseille (on loan from Inter Milan) won the 2. Bundesliga in his first season with VfB Stuttgart in 2017. Who is he?
q.e: Benjamin Pavard (French; born 28 March 1996) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Marseille, on loan from Serie A club Inter Milan, and the France national team.

q.p: Scoring 39 goals in two seasons for RB Leipzig, this Slovenian forward previously helped Red Bull Salzburg win three league titles before joining a Premier League club — who is he?
q.e: Benjamin Šeško is a Slovenian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Manchester United and the Slovenia national team.

q.p: Known in journalism as the 'F1 Supremo,' this British businessman founded the Formula One Group in 1987 and controlled the sport's commercial rights until 2017 — who is he?
q.e: Bernie Ecclestone (born 28 October 1930) is a British business magnate, motorsport executive and former racing driver.

q.p: One of only 90 survivors from his original 1,000-man regiment, this ex-prisoner of war became a celebrated professional goalkeeper in England — who is he?
q.e: Bert Trautmann (22 October 1923 - 19 July 2013) was a German professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper.

q.p: This Manchester City forward holds the WSL's all-time assist record and helped England win the 2022 Euros as the tournament's top scorer — who is she?
q.e: Beth Mead (born 9 May 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for the Women's Super League (WSL) club Manchester City and the England national team.

q.p: A member of India's 2013 ICC Champions Trophy-winning squad, this bowler is the only player to win the IPL's Purple Cap in two straight seasons — who is he?
q.e: Bhuvneshwar Kumar (born 5 February 1990) is an Indian cricketer who has played for the Indian cricket team in all three formats of the game.

q.p: Ranked as high as world No. 4, this Canadian player won the Orange Bowl and reached a career-best junior ranking of No. 3 before her breakout 2019 season — who is she?
q.e: Bianca Andreescu (Romanian; born June 16, 2000) is a Canadian professional tennis player.

q.p: A unanimous All-American running back at Texas in 2022, he went eighth overall to Atlanta in the 2023 NFL draft — who is he?
q.e: Bijan Robinson (b-zhahn; born January 30, 2002) is an American professional football running back for the Atlanta Falcons of the National Football League (NFL).

q.p: This legendary Oregon Ducks track coach trained 22 NCAA champions before co-founding an athletic-shoe giant and designing the waffle-soled trainer that helped build it — who is he?
q.e: Bill Bowerman (February 19, 1911 - December 24, 1999) was an American track and field coach and co-founder of Nike.

q.p: The only NFL coach to take four different franchises to the playoffs, this 'Big Tuna' won two Super Bowl titles as head coach of the Giants — who is he?
q.e: Bill Parcells (par-SELZ; born August 22, 1941) is an American former football coach who served as a head coach in the National Football League (NFL) for 19 seasons.

q.p: The centerpiece of a Boston dynasty, this center won 11 NBA titles in 13 years after leading San Francisco to back-to-back NCAA crowns — who is it?
q.e: Bill Russell (February 12, 1934 - July 31, 2022) was an American professional basketball player who played center for the Boston Celtics of the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 1956 to 1969.

q.p: At 29 she beat a 55-year-old in the 1973 "Battle of the Sexes," then founded the Women's Tennis Association and racked up 39 Grand Slam titles. Which equality-crusading champion?
q.e: Billie Jean King (ne Moffitt; born November 22, 1943) is an American former world No.
